title: Purportedly AI-Enhanced Arrest Image Reportedly Led Viewers to Mistake a Girl for a Boy in Metz, France
summary: A purportedly clearer, AI-modified frame from an arrest video in Metz, France, reportedly showed additional facial and body hair and a different shirt pattern. Viewers cited it as evidence that the arrested person was a boy, although she was a 14-year-old girl. The altered image allegedly distorted public interpretation of the arrest footage.
